ui_bugs.issue: Trailing space is placed INSIDE each inline-block motion.span. Browsers collapse trailing whitespace inside inline-block elements, so the animated blockquote on Home ('Why Cyber Security Matters') renders as 'Cyberthreatsareevolvingrapidly.Proactivepreventionisalwaysmoreeffectiveandcost-efficientthanrecovery' with no spaces between words. TitleReveal already solves this by using a non-breaking space ('\u00A0') as a sibling of the inline-block; WordReveal should do the same. One-line fix: replace `{i < words.length - 1 ? " " : ""}` inside the motion.span with `{word}` only, and render `{i < words.length - 1 ? "\u00A0" : ""}` OUTSIDE the motion.span (or set whiteSpace:'pre' on the wrapper).

Form field testids do not match the names listed in the review request (`contact-name`, `contact-email`, `contact-phone`, `contact-message`, `contact-submit`). Actual testids in code are `input-full-name`, `input-email`, `input-phone`, `input-message`, `contact-submit-button`. Fields work, but if the acceptance checklist expects those exact names, either the code or the checklist should be aligned.

rca of the issue: WordReveal renders each word inside a motion.span with className='inline-block' and appends ' ' (a plain space) as the last text node INSIDE that same inline-block. Because the space is the trailing character inside an inline-block, browsers collapse it (CSS whitespace-collapsing rules for inline-block boundaries). Result: all words render flush against each other. The sibling component TitleReveal in the same file avoids this by putting a non-breaking space ('\u00A0') OUTSIDE the inline-block motion.span. Reproduction: open https://mits-stage.preview.emergentagent.com/ , scroll to section '03 Why Cyber Security Matters'. Mitigation: mirror TitleReveal's structure in WordReveal — wrap the motion.span with a parent span and put `\u00A0` between siblings, or set style={{whiteSpace:'pre'}} on the outer motion.span.
